description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseRealtimeConfig' which specifies the interface and default behavior for configuring and handling real-time language model transformations within the project. It includes methods for environment validation, URL generation, error handling, request transformation, and response transformation.

classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for real-time configuration, including methods for environment validation, URL construction, error handling, request and response transformation, and session management.
